Parent issue: #443

Stage: answer-guidance

## Task

Implement the next small slice for issue #443, stacked on PR #447: update the answer route prompt so when Sepo stays in answer mode for planning, discussion, ambiguity, or unsupported requests, it can teach the user concrete follow-up slash commands only when useful. Keep the behavior concise and non-boilerplate: suggest commands such as `@sepo-agent /implement ...`, `/fix-pr ...`, `/review`, or `/orchestrate ...` when the user's request naturally points to a next action, and explain briefly when Sepo intentionally stayed in answer mode because the wording was planning-shaped rather than an explicit change request. Prefer focused edits to `.github/prompts/agent-answer.md` and existing prompt/envelope tests such as `.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts`; avoid dispatch metadata plumbing or broader router changes in this slice unless a failing test shows it is necessary.

## Base

- base_pr: #447
